description: FREE. Screen one crypto wallet address against the OFAC SDN list's 'Digital Currency Address' entries (BTC/XBT, ETH, USDT, TRX, LTC, XMR, SOL and more). EVM 0x addresses match case-insensitively, others exactly. Returns match/no match with SDN name, UID, programs, list date and source. Screening aid only, not legal or compliance advice; check the official OFAC list.
name: crypto_address_check
